calculation.description: Ranks assets by lagged 60-day risk-adjusted average return multiplied by directional consistency. The one-day lag prevents use of the current completed day's return in the decision signal.

validation.regime_notes: Full-history window begins after the 60-day warmup and uses 2,242 cross-sectional dates with at least 8 valid instruments. Recent 120/260/520/780-day IC values were 0.015825/0.102349/0.057821/0.056140; corresponding ICIR values were 0.045881/0.312160/0.177753/0.178213. Short recent ICIR is below the admission threshold, so usage should be conservative and revalidated promptly. Coverage is reduced by requiring 45 observations per asset and simultaneous valid returns; interpret small-universe estimates cautiously.
